pending_interview.question: You are given a list of integers representing the daily prices of a stock. You want to find the maximum profit you can make by making at most two non-overlapping buy-sell transactions (you must sell before you buy again, and you cannot hold more than one share at a time). Walk me through your approach — including how you'd think about the time and space complexity of your solution — and explain why a simple single-pass greedy approach (like the one that works for one transaction) breaks down here.
